conclusion.correctness: All declared targeted gates pass; no full-game or all-device guarantee.
conclusion.release: No >50ms registered RAF wait or active callback wall time among the 26077 identified game RAF requests that entered the active body. No claim that all scheduling stalls are fixed.
conclusion.longGaps: Candidate has fewer >100ms new-state gaps in these runs, but more >50ms gaps. Long-tail smoothness is not uniformly improved.
conclusion.recommendation: Keep the user-tested baseline as the default. Retain this narrow, source-reviewed candidate without changing pacing; consider adoption as a memory-copy optimization rather than a promised FPS upgrade.
